selections.rationale:
- Minimal correction: The held witness hides an own assetId patch key; Object.keys omits it and the forbidden patch is accepted. Use all-own-key validation for patch keys and exact asset shape, preserving field order, distinct output, validation-before-return and patch-only trimming.
- Contract decision/scope: Make own-field scope explicit: the asset has exactly the four own fields; patch permits only own label/category/active, including non-enumerable fields; symbols/unknown own keys reject. Inherited extras are not patch inputs. This resolves the existing Object.keys/hasOwn mismatch rather than requiring descriptor cloning.
- Specification-grounded independent tests and substantive scope: Hidden assetId and hidden/symbol unknown keys must throw; hidden allowed fields update; exact own required fields remain usable even when hidden. Preserve empty patch, immutable identity, error classes, output order and atomic rejection after a valid earlier field. Whole-target value is interacting exact-shape, protected-key, normalization and atomic-copy rules, not a key-name substitution.

- Minimal correction: Toggle spreads a supplied ticket, dropping a directly readable hidden title. Materialize id/title/details/status on changed records and nextId/tickets on changed roots, retaining untouched ticket identities.
- Contract decision/scope: Recognized-action payload errors keep their specific TypeError rule; generic malformed/unknown actions remain identity no-ops. No deep-copy, arbitrary descriptor preservation, unsafe-counter extension or unrelated ID-policy change is requested.
- Specification-grounded independent tests and substantive scope: Supply valid external state with hidden title/details and hidden nextId; toggle twice and delete preserve required fields, counter and unaffected identities. Include ordinary add-after-delete order/ID behavior, no-op identities, frozen initial state and invalid payloads. This is an ordered immutable lifecycle.

- Minimal correction: Raw indexed access reads inherited values for holes despite explicit sparse-as-undefined behavior. Use own-index existence before reading the value supplied to mapper/fallback.
- Contract decision/scope: An absent own index is undefined even if an Array-derived local prototype has that index. Do not mutate Array.prototype globally or introduce unspecified callback-driven length policy.
- Specification-grounded independent tests and substantive scope: Use a one-hole array with a local prototype index 0:7; mapper and failing mapper's fallback must both receive undefined. Retain dense own-index access, every-index ordering, original thrown-error identity, callback result identity, immediate fallback throw and input non-mutation. Error/fallback/control-flow interactions make the target substantive.

- Minimal correction: Failure messages use trim-empty rejection instead of the stated non-empty-string rule. Change only that validation to length===0 and replace conflicting original whitespace-rejection oracle.
- Contract decision/scope: Keep save-start name validation explicitly trim-based. No error clearing on edit beyond stated transitions, no phase-transition restrictions, and no optional-extra preservation promise.
- Specification-grounded independent tests and substantive scope: Failure message consisting of spaces must enter error phase with the exact message and fresh values/saved copies; empty/non-string still reject. Retain load/save/edit interaction, saved-vs-live detachment, previous-state nonmutation and unsupported action errors. Original tests must be regenerated independently, not blindly appended.

- Minimal correction: POST/PUT reject whitespace-only text although text need only be nonempty. Change both body text predicates to length-based and remove the conflicting old POST oracle.
- Contract decision/scope: Retain exact method/path routing, absent-item response before PUT body validation as existing ordered behavior, non-array request/body validation and unchanged text storage. No URL decoding/normalization or real HTTP behavior added.
- Specification-grounded independent tests and substantive scope: Create then update an item with whitespace text, assert exact snapshots and ID accounting; empty/non-string bodies reject without consuming creation IDs. Cover isolated dispatchers, deleted IDs, malformed paths/query tails, mutation of request/output and subsequent GET. Complete stateful CRUD/snapshot behavior is substantive.

- Minimal correction: Assigning an own JSON __proto__ key into {} changes clone's prototype; a later clone no longer sees a plain object and returns internal storage directly. Define own data keys safely during recursive cloning, preserving nested JSON values.
- Contract decision/scope: Scope remains acyclic JSON-compatible inputs as promised. Own JSON __proto__, constructor and prototype are ordinary data keys. Do not expand into an arbitrary object serializer, add cyclic-input semantics, or require prototype/descriptor preservation beyond safe copied data.
- Specification-grounded independent tests and substantive scope: Use JSON.parse-created root and nested __proto__ objects across initial/get/list/replace; assert own-key/value preservation and mutate every returned graph to show storage isolation. Retain shared-input detachment, order-preserving replacement, duplicates, empty/unknown behavior and invalid ID errors.

- Minimal correction: Shared validation treats undefined handler as publish's omission even in on/off. Split required-handler validation from topic-only publish validation.
- Contract decision/scope: on/off require functions including omitted/explicit undefined rejection; publish accepts arbitrary/omitted payload. Same-function registration remains idempotent, unlike selected TypeScript independent-registration APIs.
- Specification-grounded independent tests and substantive scope: Assert omitted and undefined on/off handlers throw without registering anything; later valid publish still works. Retain handler registration order, Set idempotence, unsubscribe/off Boolean semantics, snapshot add/remove, payload identity and immediate exception propagation.

- Minimal correction: Object.keys patch validation misses unknown non-enumerable own properties. Validate every own key (including symbols) against description/quantity before looking up absence.
- Contract decision/scope: The prompt explicitly says only permitted own properties; this covers non-enumerable names and symbols without invoking inherited extras. Hidden allowed fields remain supported. Preserve validation-before-absence and existing normalizations.
- Specification-grounded independent tests and substantive scope: Unknown hidden/symbol property must throw for absent and present SKU; hidden description/quantity applies when valid and rejects atomically when malformed. Keep normalized duplicate SKU, case sensitivity, insertion order, empty patch, detached snapshots and unknown return values.

- Minimal correction: Fix duplicate registration removal with tokens. Full read also finds spread-only copies of required Workshop, WorkshopRow and WorkshopFilter fields, which can lose typed non-enumerable properties; explicitly materialize those named fields wherever copied.
- Contract decision/scope: Required typed fields need not be enumerable. Do not clone unspecified extras. Preserve source mapping order, transactional rows on mapper/loader failure, once-only reports, cancelled dialog behavior and reset-filter emission only after successful reload.
- Specification-grounded independent tests and substantive scope: A,B,A unsubscribe-last ordering; typed objects with required hidden fields in loader input, mapper output and emitted filter; each listener gets a distinct correct copy. Keep asynchronous rejection/report identity, dialog cancel/failure and failed-map atomicity. Fresh property issue is static selection evidence, not a newly executed failure.

- Minimal correction: Tokenize subscriptions so removing final duplicate retains original order. Preserve repeated-set notifications and fresh frozen snapshot per delivery.
- Contract decision/scope: Explicit supplied undefined initial values remain invalid under current prompt; omitted panels default false. No new runtime validation domain for typed setters or new recursive/reentrant snapshot guarantee.
- Specification-grounded independent tests and substantive scope: A,B,A unsubscribe-last yields A,B after setVisible/toggle; constructor default/explicit-undefined behavior, frozen distinct snapshots, repeated same-value notification, snapshot subscription mutation and exception propagation with committed state.

- Minimal correction: Tokenize account-specific subscriptions. Full read additionally reveals dollar-anchored regex permits a terminal newline despite canonical notation's no-whitespace rule; require complete input consumption.
- Contract decision/scope: Retain bigint scale/rounding-free arithmetic, immediate subscribe callback, exact case-sensitive identifiers, no duplicate-value emission and account/allowance separation. No inferred rollback policy for throwing immediate subscriber; no amount-size cap added.
- Specification-grounded independent tests and substantive scope: A,B,A unsubscribe-last after clearing mandatory immediate calls; parseAmount('1\n') and terminal CR/CRLF/U+2028/U+2029 must reject at decimals 0 and 2, while canonical large numbers and 18-place values work. Preserve snapshot delivery, exceptions, format/parse boundaries and validations. Regex finding is static, not newly executed.

- Minimal correction: Use unique listener registration identity instead of first function match. Preserve ordered mutations, commit-before-listener-error and returned/event/state detachment.
- Contract decision/scope: Per-listener event isolation is not promised: do not introduce it as an oracle. Each unsubscribe belongs to its subscription; failed operations emit nothing. No new numeric ID range contract added.
- Specification-grounded independent tests and substantive scope: A,B,A remove last -> A,B on append/rename/remove/promote; snapshot removal during delivery still calls captured listeners. Retain promotion relative order, no ID reuse in bounded sequences, validation before mutation, event detachment and committed state on throw.

- Minimal correction: Parameter dictionary assignment loses __proto__ rather than storing its raw captured string. Use safe own data-property insertion or null-prototype intermediate, preserving safe final copying.
- Contract decision/scope: Any nonempty parameter name permitted by pattern grammar is data, including __proto__/constructor. Do not require a specific params prototype, URL decoding or new trailing-slash policy.
- Specification-grounded independent tests and substantive scope: Match /:__proto__ with /value and assert own property plus exact value; add constructor/toString names, multiple params, fresh independent result maps, specificity ties, fallback, duplicate parameter rejection and unchanged input order.

- Minimal correction: Unknown, missing-route-separator and incomplete marker fallback paths append raw slices, violating universal escaping. Apply one unescape pass to fallback ordinary text without reinterpreting escaped delimiters as markers.
- Contract decision/scope: Retain trailing backslash literal, first unescaped route pipe, no nesting, empty fields, source order and coalescing. Do not turn malformed markers into exceptions or double-unescape output.
- Specification-grounded independent tests and substantive scope: Unknown {{unknown:a\\*b}}, malformed route and incomplete marker each remove escape backslash once; doubled/trailing backslash remain correct. Retain recognized escaped closers/pipes, empty payloads, adjacent text coalescing and stateless repeated calls.
